methods.label: Identify cylinder dimensions and calculate volume
methods.explanation: Rotating about the longer side gives a cylinder with height 4 and base radius 3. Its volume is \(V=\pi\times3^2\times4=36\pi=36\times3.14=113.04\).
methods.levelReason: The solution combines Grade 7 visualization of a moving surface with the Grade 6 cylinder-volume and circle-area formulas and elementary decimal multiplication.
